description: She wears an ivory floor-length patterned dress with a neckline near the collarbones and long sleeves to the wrists. Gold-and-dark geometric embroidered borders decorate the bodice, waist and sleeve cuffs. A long muted purple-brown outer layer and shoulder drape with richly patterned edging fall to the hem. A broad decorated belt, hanging round pendants and small gold earrings add ornament. Gold-brown patterned shoes are visible beneath the hem; her head is bare.
